mapper.select: SELECT id FROM daily_action_item WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND conversion_status_code IN ('01', '02') AND target_date = CURDATE() AND is_completed = 0 ORDER BY priority_score DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT cs.id AS scriptId, cs.action_item_id AS actionItemId, cs.customer_id AS customerId, cs.conversion_status_code AS conversionStatusCode, dai.trigger_type_code AS triggerTypeCode, cc.code_name AS triggerName, cs.script_content AS scriptContent, cs.created_at AS createdAt FROM customer_script cs LEFT JOIN daily_action_item dai ON dai.id = cs.action_item_id LEFT JOIN common_code cc ON cc.group_code = 'TRIGGER_TYPE' AND cc.code_value = dai.trigger_type_code WHERE cs.action_item_id = #{actionItemId} AND cs.created_at >= CURDATE() AND cs.created_at < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY cs.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT dai.id AS actionItemId, dai.customer_id AS customerId, dai.conversion_status_code AS conversionStatusCode, dai.trigger_type_code AS triggerTypeCode, cc.code_name AS triggerName,
CASE WHEN dai.conversion_status_code = '01' THEN pc.name WHEN dai.conversion_status_code = '02' THEN child.name END AS childName,
CASE WHEN dai.conversion_status_code = '01' THEN pc.birth_date WHEN dai.conversion_status_code = '02' THEN child.birth_date END AS childBirthDate,
CASE WHEN dai.conversion_status_code = '01' THEN pc.gender WHEN dai.conversion_status_code = '02' THEN child.gender END AS childGender,
CASE WHEN dai.conversion_status_code = '01' THEN parent_from_potential.name WHEN dai.conversion_status_code = '02' THEN parent_from_integrated.name END AS parentName,
CASE WHEN dai.conversion_status_code = '01' THEN parent_from_potential.birth_date WHEN dai.conversion_status_code = '02' THEN parent_from_integrated.birth_date END AS parentBirthDate,
CASE WHEN dai.conversion_status_code = '01' THEN parent_from_potential.gender WHEN dai.conversion_status_code = '02' THEN parent_from_integrated.gender END AS parentGender
FROM daily_action_item dai
LEFT JOIN potential_customer pc ON dai.conversion_status_code = '01' AND pc.id = dai.customer_id
LEFT JOIN integrated_customer parent_from_potential ON dai.conversion_status_code = '01' AND parent_from_potential.integrated_customer_id = pc.parent_customer_id
LEFT JOIN integrated_customer child ON dai.conversion_status_code = '02' AND child.integrated_customer_id = dai.customer_id
LEFT JOIN integrated_customer parent_from_integrated ON dai.conversion_status_code = '02' AND parent_from_integrated.integrated_customer_id = child.parent_id
JOIN common_code cc ON cc.group_code = 'TRIGGER_TYPE' AND cc.code_value = dai.trigger_type_code
WHERE dai.id = #{actionItemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_script ( customer_id, conversion_status_code, action_item_id, script_content ) VALUES ( #{customerId}, #{conversionStatusCode}, #{actionItemId}, #{scriptContent} )
